# dawn

Prebuilt Dawn install tree (headers + CMake package config + platform
libraries), used by the WebGPU rendering device driver for the
`dawn-desktop` and `emdawnwebgpu` build paths.

- Upstream: https://github.com/google/dawn (mirror of
  https://dawn.googlesource.com/dawn)
- Version: `1e897275172a23f27b0022fa6beae3084ed54a9b` (see `TAG`)
- License: BSD-3-Clause (see `google/dawn/LICENSE` at the pinned SHA)

Files:

- `include/webgpu/*` and `include/dawn/*` — public C and C++ WebGPU
  headers emitted by Dawn's build at the pinned SHA.
- `lib/cmake/Dawn/*` — `DawnConfig.cmake` and friends produced by Dawn's
  install target, so a consuming build can `find_package(Dawn)`.

This directory is the **install output** of a Dawn build, not a source
snapshot, so it cannot be regenerated by a simple file copy. To update:
build `google/dawn` at the new SHA with the standard install target,
copy the resulting `include/` and `lib/` trees here, then bump `TAG`.
